segments.name: Real estate segment
segments.description: Renovates and resells condominium units and develops residential condominiums, selling to individuals and institutional purchasers.
segments.evidence: This increase was partially offset by a decrease in our sales in condominium renovation.

segments.name: Hotel segment
segments.description: Operates ryokan-style hotels in urban areas, targeting families and international tourists.
segments.evidence: ProstyleRyokan targeted the area by operating a Machinaka Ryokan, a ryokan-style hotel, and designing all common areas and guest rooms to meet ryokan specifications, with approximately 70% of the guest rooms including open-air baths.

segments.name: other segment
segments.description: Remaining operations reported beside the real estate and hotel segments, with no products named in the filing.
segments.evidence: The Group has three reportable segments: Real estate segment, Hotel segment and other segment, which are based on the Group's organizational structure and characteristics of products and services.

revenueModel.text: Buyers of renovated and developed condominiums, and guests staying at hotels, pay the company directly.
revenueModel.evidence: The concept of the hotels managed by ProstyleRyokan is to provide guests with the experience of staying in a ryokan-style hotel, which is typically in suburban tourist destinations, while providing the convenience of an urban location.
